title: EU Criticizes US Sanctions on ICC
body: The European Commission called it deeply regrettable that the United States has announced intentions to impose sanctions on the International Criminal Court. The Commission added that the EU has been a constant supporter of the ICC and will work closely with the court to ensure it continues to operate effectively.

title: Germany to Release 15M Barrels
body: Germany will release up to 15 million barrels of oil and petroleum products from its emergency reserves under the G7 agreement on energy stockpiles. Diesel and heating oil go first, with crude oil to follow. Germany's economy minister called refineries critical to national energy security.

title: الجمعيات ودوائر القرار.. كيف يعمل نفوذ الإخوان في أوروبا؟
body: أعاد تحرك البرلمان الأوروبي لتشديد الرقابة على الشبكات المرتبطة بتنظيم الإخوان تسليط الضوء على نفوذ المؤسسات والجمعيات التي تتهمها سلطات أوروبية بالارتباط بالتنظيم، وقدرتها على الوصول إلى دوائر صنع القرار عبر الأنشطة الاجتماعية والدينية والتعليمية، وسط مطالب بمراجعة التمويل العام والعلاقات المؤسسية.

title: ترامب: 22 مليون برميل عبرت هرمز في ليلة واحدة
body: أعلن الرئيس الأميركي دونالد ترامب أن 22 مليون برميل من النفط عبرت مضيق هرمز خلال ليلة واحدة، بالتزامن مع تعهده بعدم شن هجوم جديد على إيران قبل انتخابات التجديد النصفي للكونغرس المقررة في الثالث من نوفمبر.

title: New horizons open for Iran-Afghanistan economic co-op during Iran’s trade delegation’s trip to Kabul
body: TEHRAN- During the trip of a trade delegation from the Iran Chamber of Commerce, Industries, Mines and Agriculture (ICCIMA), led by Ghadir Qiyafeh, Vice President of the Chamber, to Kabul, the capacities for Iran-Afghanistan cooperation in mining and mineral industries, agriculture and conversion industries, technology transfer, and the creation of production and processing chains were examined.

title: New investment opportunities reviewed in meeting between Yazd entrepreneurs, South Korean ambassador
body: TEHRAN- The meeting of the entrepreneurs of Yazd Province with the South Korean Ambassador was held at the Yazd Chamber of Commerce, Industries, Mines, and Agriculture, with the aim of developing economic diplomacy and expanding trade relations.

title: Pezeshkian urges Caspian states to unite on long-term environmental protection plan

title: Iranian students win BRICS Smart City 2030 Award
body: TEHRAN – A team of three students from Sharif University of Technology has won first place in the third International Student and Young Scientist Project Competition, “SMART CITY 2030,” held in Moscow on October 5–6.
